audio_transcription: Customer: Hi, I have an issue with my bill. Agent: I can help with that. First, could you please confirm your Account PIN? Customer: Sure, it's 1234. Agent: PIN verified. What seems to be the issue? Customer: I was overcharged. Agent: I apologize for the inconvenience. Let me check... I see the error and have refunded $10. Customer: Thanks.
Customer: Hi, I need to check my last bill. Agent: Okay, I see your bill is $50. Customer: Why is it so high? Agent: It includes a late fee.
Customer: Why is my internet so slow? I'm really angry! Agent: I don't know. It works fine for everyone else.
